quickInfo.name: Colored top lanes
quickInfo.summary: The plunge can light one bumper to improve its value while it advances its center-value color.

quickInfo.name: Red value
quickInfo.summary: Red-bumper hits advance the red center light through its value sequence.

quickInfo.name: Yellow value
quickInfo.summary: Yellow-bumper hits advance the yellow center light through its value sequence.

quickInfo.name: Center target
quickInfo.summary: The center target scores only 10 points unless the red and yellow lights match, when it can score up to 300 points.

quickInfo.name: Upper play
quickInfo.summary: Shots beside the bumpers return the ball to the top lanes and can advance both color values.

steps.text: Plunge for a colored top lane. Note which bumper becomes lit.
Send controlled shots beside the bumpers to return the ball to the upper playfield.
Use red-bumper hits to advance the red center value.
Use yellow-bumper hits to advance the yellow center value.
Compare the two center lights after each bumper sequence. Do not shoot the center target while the values differ.
When both colors show the same value, shoot the center target. Repeat the upper-play route for the next match.

fallback.title: Upper-play scoring
fallback.when: Use this when the center target rebound is unsafe or the two values are far apart.

steps.text: Shoot beside the bumpers instead of at the center target.
Use the top lanes and lit bumper for steady scoring.
Watch the two color values as the bumpers advance them.
Return to the center target only after a useful match appears.

alternatives.title: Low-value center collect
alternatives.when: Use this when the values match and the center target has a predictable rebound.

steps.text: Confirm that the red and yellow values match.
Shoot the center target from the controlled flipper.
Return the next safe feed to the upper playfield.
Advance both color lights through repeated bumper hits.
Let a color roll past Special and return to 50 when needed.
Match the red and yellow lights at 300.
Shoot the center target before another bumper changes either value.

playfieldReferences.label: Center value target
playfieldReferences.description: Center target that collects when the red and yellow values match.
playfieldReferences.context: Shoot the center target only when both values match.

techniques.name: Useful plunge lane
techniques.instruction: Adjust the plunge to enter the top lane that lights the most useful bumper on this machine.

cautions.issue: Bumper exits can feed the center drain or the slingshots.
cautions.response: Keep both flippers ready. Do not flip the ball back into a bumper from a poor feed.

cautions.issue: Side lanes can enter a slingshot and continue toward an outlane.
cautions.response: Watch the first side-lane exit. Nudge only after you learn its normal path.

input.simpleOverview: Subway and Cross Town use red- and yellow-bumper hits to move two center values. Plunge a colored top lane to light its bumper, build both colors until their displayed values match, then shoot the center target for the combined award.
input.overview: In Subway and Cross Town, each colored top lane lights the matching bumper. Red-bumper hits raise the red value below the center target, and yellow-bumper hits raise the yellow value. Shoot the center target only when the two displayed values match because an unmatched pair pays just 10 points.
